changelog: Integrations overhaul: removed unused OAuth flows (HubSpot/Salesforce/Pipedrive) — external tools now route via Zapier/Make/n8n. Fixed Telegram (accepts bot token + chat_id, no more constructing URLs). Added Slack/Discord webhook URL validation with error surfacing. Added Send Test button per integration. Discord messages now branded with your app name/logo. Slack now catches invalid_payload and other non-2xx errors.
